title: Compile-database input reaches a file-read boundary without a private capture-root contract
title_de: Der Compile-Database-Input erreicht eine Datei-Lesegrenze ohne Vertrag für eine private Capture-Root
summary: Before PR #98, non-verify CLI input reached load_database(...).read_text after only a basic file check and had no explicit capture-root provenance or containment contract. Exact PR #98 head a2f2dd1f8bd2c433ee4cb107a0bf94281fbd7640 was protected-squash-merged as master 3311f3fd0e6dee01efc905e62f55bbdb3490ad20. All 14 applicable master-push workflows passed, and the three targeted base Sonar keys are CLOSED/FIXED. The project-wide Quality Gate remains ERROR for separately tracked baseline backlog and is not attributed to this remediation.
summary_de: Vor PR #98 erreichte nicht verifizierter CLI-Input load_database(...).read_text nach nur einer grundlegenden Dateiprüfung und ohne expliziten Vertrag für Capture-Root-Provenance oder Containment. Der exakte PR-#98-Head a2f2dd1f8bd2c433ee4cb107a0bf94281fbd7640 wurde geschützt per Squash als master 3311f3fd0e6dee01efc905e62f55bbdb3490ad20 gemergt. Alle 14 anwendbaren Master-Push-Workflows bestanden, und die drei zielgerichteten Basis-Sonar-Keys sind CLOSED/FIXED. Das projektweite Quality Gate bleibt wegen eines getrennt verfolgten Basis-Backlogs ERROR und wird dieser Remediation nicht zugerechnet.
observed_behavior: At the pre-remediation base, a non-verify --input value could reach load_database and Path.read_text without an explicit private capture-root requirement. Static Sonar key AZ9dWiALxi9ITghe3pzq recorded this as a high-impact pythonsecurity:S8707 candidate. The current repository call sites are CI-owned wrappers rather than a demonstrated remote or cross-principal CLI service.
observed_behavior_de: Auf der Basis vor der Remediation konnte ein nicht verifizierter --input-Wert load_database und Path.read_text ohne explizite Anforderung an eine private Capture-Root erreichen. Der statische Sonar-Key AZ9dWiALxi9ITghe3pzq erfasste dies als Kandidat mit hoher Auswirkung für pythonsecurity:S8707. Die aktuellen Repository-Call-Sites sind CI-eigene Wrapper und kein belegter Remote- oder Cross-Principal-CLI-Service.
expected_behavior: Every non-verify input must be an absolute existing regular file that resolves outside the checkout and beneath an absolute, non-symlinked, current-user-owned external capture root that is not group writable or accessible by others. The validator must enforce that boundary before the JSON file-read sink; a valid private capture must remain accepted.
expected_behavior_de: Jeder nicht verifizierte Input muss eine absolute vorhandene reguläre Datei sein, die außerhalb des Checkouts und unterhalb einer absoluten, nicht verlinkten, externen Capture-Root im Besitz des aktuellen Benutzers aufgelöst wird, die weder gruppenbeschreibbar noch für andere zugänglich ist. Der Validator muss diese Grenze vor dem JSON-Dateilesesink erzwingen; ein gültiger privater Capture muss weiter akzeptiert werden.
impact: Without the contract, a caller could direct the CI helper to parse an arbitrary readable file path. The strongest evidence supports a CI-local path-integrity candidate, not a proven remote exploit or a distinct untrusted same-UID attacker path. The PR-specific security review found no validated high- or critical-impact regression in the remediation.
impact_de: Ohne den Vertrag konnte ein Aufrufer den CI-Helper zum Parsen eines beliebigen lesbaren Dateipfads veranlassen. Die stärkste Evidenz stützt einen CI-lokalen Pfadintegritätskandidaten, keinen bewiesenen Remote-Exploit oder einen eigenständigen untrusted Same-UID-Angreiferpfad. Das PR-spezifische Security-Review fand keine validierte Regression mit hoher oder kritischer Auswirkung in der Remediation.
preconditions: A non-verify invocation supplies --input to ci/checks/analysis/compile_database.py.
The invocation reaches the JSON parsing branch.
For material security impact beyond the CI-local candidate, an untrusted caller or cross-principal write/read relationship would need to be demonstrated.
reproduction: Inspect the pre-remediation non-verify branch where --input reaches load_database(...).read_text without a capture-root contract.

At exact PR #98 head a2f2dd1f8bd2c433ee4cb107a0bf94281fbd7640, exercise missing root, relative input, checkout input, symlink escape, symlink loop, unsafe root permissions, and a root symlink; each must fail before parsing/publishing.
Exercise a regular JSON input beneath a private 0700 capture root as the legitimate control.

security_assessment.security_invariant: The capture input must establish private external-root provenance and containment before load_database reads JSON.
security_assessment.trust_boundary: CLI capture path -> capture-root/input validation -> load_database -> Path.read_text
security_assessment.counterevidence_and_limits: Current production call sites are two CI-owned Bear wrappers that create a fresh mktemp capture directory and pass the fixed local file plus root. A theoretical same-EUID replacement between validation and read was assessed, but no distinct attacker-controlled writer in the private root or cross-principal boundary is evidenced. The adjacent output-path boundary is unchanged and outside this finding.

root_cause: The original non-verify flow treated the CLI input as a file after only a basic file check. It did not bind the input to a private external Bear capture root before the read sink.
root_cause_de: Der ursprüngliche nicht verifizierte Ablauf behandelte den CLI-Input nach nur einer grundlegenden Dateiprüfung als Datei. Er band den Input vor dem Lesesink nicht an eine private externe Bear-Capture-Root.
proposed_remediation: Keep PR #98's narrow validation boundary: require --capture-root whenever --input is used, validate the root's path class, ownership and permissions, strictly resolve and confine the input, and pass only the validated result to load_database. Preserve the private mktemp wrapper flow and the valid private-capture control.
proposed_remediation_de: Die enge Validierungsgrenze von PR #98 beibehalten: --capture-root verlangen, wenn --input verwendet wird, Pfadklasse, Eigentümerschaft und Rechte der Root prüfen, den Input strikt auflösen und begrenzen und nur das validierte Ergebnis an load_database übergeben. Den privaten mktemp-Wrapper-Ablauf und das gültige Private-Capture-Control beibehalten.
acceptance_criteria: Exact PR #98 head a2f2dd1f8bd2c433ee4cb107a0bf94281fbd7640 rejects missing root, relative input, checkout input, escape/loop symlinks, unsafe root permissions, root symlink, and invalid verify-only combination before parsing or publishing.
The same exact head accepts a valid capture beneath a private 0700 external root and preserves compilation-database filtering, merge and atomic-publication controls.

The focused 7-test diagnostics suite, 11-test bilingual documentation suite, wrapper syntax checks, diff check, required checks, CodeQL, OSV, SonarCloud PR check, and Sonar Quality Gate pass on the exact head without suppression, false-positive disposition, exclusion, rule change, or Quality-Gate change.
The PR is protected-squash-merged only at the exact checked head; resulting master 3311f3fd0e6dee01efc905e62f55bbdb3490ad20 and all 14 applicable master-push workflows are verified.
A post-merge master Sonar analysis records AZ9dWiALxi9ITghe3pzq, AZ9dWiALxi9ITghe3pzp and AZ9dWiALxi9ITghe3pzo as CLOSED/FIXED.
validation_plan: Retain the protected-delivery and exact-master Sonar evidence for PR #98.

Existing valid compilation-database merge and verify behavior remains covered by the focused diagnostics suite.
dependencies: Optional Bear/compiler integration prerequisites were not required for the focused boundary suite.
evidence_limitations: The current evidence is tool-observed in this task and has no separately retained receipt file.
The focused tests do not execute a full Bear/compiler capture integration.
No remote exploit, separate untrusted same-UID caller, or cross-principal writer in the private capture root is demonstrated.
The adjacent external output-path boundary is pre-existing and outside this input-confinement finding.
residual_risk: A same-EUID TOCTOU scenario is not reportable on current evidence because no distinct untrusted writer can access the private root; reassess if the tool becomes a cross-principal interface. The separate project-wide Sonar Quality Gate ERROR remains tracked elsewhere.
residual_risk_de: Ein Same-EUID-TOCTOU-Szenario ist nach der aktuellen Evidenz nicht reportable, weil kein eigenständiger untrusted Writer auf die private Root zugreifen kann; bei einer späteren Cross-Principal-Schnittstelle neu bewerten. Das getrennte projektweite Sonar-Quality-Gate-ERROR bleibt anderweitig verfolgt.
